sale_policy.instructions: 1. Apply sale filter with exact condition: product price equals 39. 2. Keep stock constraints active and show only in-stock or low-stock sale items. 3. Apply any additional user filters: brand, type, color, gender, size, sizes, budget. 4. Present sale items in concise list-first format. 5. Use required sale wording: On sale: was $78.
sale_policy.triggers: 1. Activate this policy when intent is sale_query. 2. Activate this policy when Prospect asks for discounts mapped to sale_query intent.
sale_policy.constraints: 1. Never include non-sale items in sale results. 2. Never alter sale threshold from price equals 39. 3. Never invent previous prices or discount percentages.
sale_policy.output_contract: 1. Lead with sale confirmation sentence. 2. Show matching sale items with price and size availability context. 3. If no match exists, ask one focused filter question or propose sale alternatives by deterministic criteria.
